name: Pinwheel
css:
.loader { --accent: var(--loader-color); --accent-2: var(--loader-secondary-color); width: var(--loader-size); height: var(--loader-size); border-radius: 10%; background: conic-gradient(var(--accent) 0deg 90deg, var(--accent-2) 90deg 180deg, var(--accent) 180deg 270deg, var(--accent-2) 270deg 360deg); clip-path: polygon(50% 50%, 100% 0, 100% 50%, 50% 50%, 100% 100%, 50% 100%, 50% 50%, 0 100%, 0 50%, 50% 50%, 0 0, 50% 0); animation: spin calc(var(--loader-speed) * 1.4) linear infinite; }
@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
